subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should this PR be allowed to merge with pre-fix production logs plus focused predicate tests, or should it wait for an organic after-fix xAI/Grok rotation capture?
rationale: The targeted xAI error is provider-side and the contributor says it cannot be faithfully induced; automation cannot produce the exact live after-fix proof, while source inspection and sibling retry precedent support the narrow code change.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: Treat the redacted production logs, OpenAI SDK error-shape contract, existing one-shot retry precedent, and new positive/negative tests as sufficient for this non-inducible provider-side failure.

options.title: Require organic after-fix proof
options.body: Hold the PR until a future xAI rotation produces redacted gateway logs showing the stripped retry succeeds in a real Grok route.

options.title: Defer to broader retry work
options.body: Pause this narrow PR if maintainers prefer to resolve the overlap through the broader open encrypted-content retry redesign instead.

recommendation.title: Accept proof override
recommendation.body: Treat the redacted production logs, OpenAI SDK error-shape contract, existing one-shot retry precedent, and new positive/negative tests as sufficient for this non-inducible provider-side failure.

likelyOwner.reason: They owned the prior merged Responses invalid-signature recovery and already documented a similar proof constraint on that surface.
